preconditions.description: Input consists of integers n (1 ≤ n ≤ 10^5) and k (0 ≤ k ≤ 10^8)
Input contains exactly two space-separated integers

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == '-1' or (all(1 <= int(x) <= 10**9 for x in stdout.split()) and len(stdout.split()) == int(n))
postconditions.description: Output is either -1 or a sequence of n distinct integers each between 1 and 10^9

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() != '-1' and sum(math.gcd(int(stdout.split()[2*i]), int(stdout.split()[2*i+1])) for i in range(int(n)//2)) == int(k)
postconditions.description: If output is not -1, the sum of gcds of consecutive pairs in the sequence equals k

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == '-1' or (int(n) >= 2 and sum(math.gcd(int(stdout.split()[2*i]), int(stdout.split()[2*i+1])) for i in range(int(n)//2)) == int(k))
postconditions.description: If n < 2, output -1 since no pairs can be formed
